name: Pearl Talisman
description: Every tile in hand: +100 chips when scored in a meld.

name: Gilded Talisman
description: Every tile in hand: +$1 when scored in a meld.

name: Polychrome Talisman
description: Every tile in hand: ×1.2 mult when scored in a meld.

name: Bamboo Talisman
description: Select tiles, then use: numbered tiles become bamboo; honors unchanged.

name: Dots Talisman
description: Select tiles, then use: numbered tiles become dots; honors unchanged.

name: Characters Talisman
description: Select tiles, then use: numbered tiles become characters; honors unchanged.

name: Honors Talisman
description: Select tiles, then use: numbered tiles become random honors; honors unchanged.

name: Wildflower Talisman
description: Select tiles, then use: every selected tile becomes a flower.

name: Conformity Talisman
description: Select tiles, then use: every selected tile becomes a copy of a random tile in your hand.
